paragraphs: We are a diversified global asset management firm with total assets under management ("AUM") of $313.8 billion, and $316.6 billion in total client assets, as of December 31, 2025. Our differentiated business model combines boutique investment qualities with the benefits of a scaled, integrated, centralized (not standardized) operating and distribution platform.

Victory Capital provides specialized investment strategies to institutions, intermediaries, retirement platforms and individual investors. With multiple Investment Franchises and a Solutions Platform that maintain autonomy in their respective investment processes, Victory Capital offers a wide array of investment products, including actively and passively managed mutual funds, rules-based and active exchange traded funds ("ETFs"), institutional separate accounts, variable insurance products ("VIPs"), alternative investments, private closed

end funds, and a 529 Education Savings Plan. Victory Capital's strategies are also offered through third-party investment products, including mutual funds, third-party ETF model strategies, retail separately managed accounts ("SMAs") and unified managed accounts ("UMAs") through wrap account programs, Collective Investment Trusts ("CITs"), and undertakings for the collective investment in transferable securities ("UCITS"). As of December 31, 2025, our Franchises and our Solutions Platform collectively managed a diversified set of 187 investment strategies.

Our design logos and the marks "Victory Capital," "Victory Capital Management," "Victory Funds," "VictoryShares," "Victory Capital inVest," "Victory Capital Solutions," "inVest," "Munder," "Munder Capital," "New Energy Capital," "Pioneer Investments," "THB," "The Road to Victory," "RS Investments," "Sycamore Capital," "Trivalent Investments," "Victory Income Investors," and "WestEnd Advisors," are pending or owned by us as of December 31, 2025. All other trademarks, service marks and trade names appearing in this report are the property of their respective owners.

Victory Capital Holdings, Inc. was formed in 2013 for the purpose of acquiring Victory Capital Management ("VCM") and Victory Capital Services, Inc. ("VCS") from KeyCorp. VCM is a U.S. registered investment adviser ("RIA") managing assets through open-end mutual funds, institutional separate accounts, CITs, wrap account programs, UCITS, private funds, and ETFs. VCM also provides mutual fund administrative services for the Victory Portfolios, Victory Variable Insurance Funds, the mutual fund series of the Victory Portfolios II, Victory Portfolios III, and Victory Portfolios IV (collectively, the "Victory Funds"), a family of open-end mutual funds, and the VictoryShares (the Company's ETF brand). Additionally, VCM employs all of the Company's United States investment professionals across its Franchises and Solutions, which are not separate legal entities.

Victory Capital Services Inc. ("VCS"), a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company, is registered with the SEC as an introducing broker-dealer and serves as distributor and underwriter for the Victory Funds and a 529 Education Savings Plan. VCS is also the placement agent for certain private funds managed by VCM. Victory Capital Transfer Agency, Inc. ("VCTA"), a wholly-owned subsidiary of Victory Capital Holdings, is registered with the SEC as a transfer agent for the Victory Funds III.

We have a purposeful strategy designed to achieve lasting profitable growth and success for our clients, our employees, and our shareholders. We have focused strategies for pursuing both organic and inorganic growth.

Organic Growth – We seek to grow organically by offering strategies that are value-added, and solution oriented to investment portfolios with strong risk-adjusted performance track records over the long term. A key driver of our growth strategy lies in enhancing the strength of our existing Investment Franchises. We primarily do this by providing them with access to our operating platform, technology, distribution, marketing, product development, and other support functions. Our centralized distribution model serves as a powerful growth engine for them by actively sourcing new clients while delivering service and reporting. By absorbing the administrative and operational complexity, we enable our investment professionals to concentrate on what they do best: managing assets and cultivating enduring client relationships. We also help our Franchises through new product development and optimizing product packaging to ensure they remain competitive and responsive to evolving market opportunities.

We continually evaluate and make investments to improve our operating platform. Recent initiatives include investments in artificial intelligence ("AI"), data and analytics, technology, product development, U.S. and International distribution, and marketing to enhance organic growth in our business and increase the effectiveness of our distribution channels.

Inorganic Growth – We complement our organic growth through strategic acquisitions. We primarily seek to acquire investment management firms that will add high quality investment teams, enhance our growth and financial profile, improve our diversification by asset class and investment capability, achieve our integration and synergy expectations, and expand our distribution capabilities.

One of our key advantages in a competitive merger and acquisition environment is our ability to provide access to multiple distribution channels. Our sales and marketing platforms drive organic growth to our acquired Investment Franchises both by opening new distribution channels and penetrating deeper into existing ones. This support from our sales and marketing professionals allows our investment professionals to focus primarily on delivering investment excellence.

Since our management‑led buyout from KeyCorp in 2013, we have successfully closed eight acquisitions, made, and exited two minority investments, and through December 31, 2025, grown our Total Client Assets 1,669% from $17.9 billion to $316.6 billion. We understand the need to execute transactions while minimizing disruption to the investment teams and to the client experience. Our team is very experienced and has a history of success in meeting those objectives. Previous acquisitions have evolved and diversified our products resulting in a mix of compelling investment strategies in asset classes where we can be successful and earn sustainable management fees.

During 2025, we closed on our strategic transaction with Amundi SA ("Amundi") to combine their U.S. operations ("Amundi US") into Victory Capital, established exclusive long-term global distribution agreements, and Amundi became a strategic shareholder of Victory Capital. The addition of Amundi US, which was rebranded back to Pioneer Investments, as our largest Investment Franchise meaningfully enhanced our scale, expanded our global client base, and further diversified our investment and product capabilities.

We regularly evaluate potential acquisition candidates and maintain a strong network of industry participants and advisors who provide opportunities to establish potential target relationships and source transactions. Our management team leads and participates in our acquisition strategy, leveraging their many years of experience actively operating our Company on a day‑to‑day basis to successfully source, execute, integrate, and ultimately operate acquired businesses.

The following is a summary of risks and uncertainties that affect our business, financial condition or results of operations. We are providing the following summary of risk factors to enhance readability of our risk factor disclosure. Material risks that may adversely affect our business, financial condition or results of operations include, but are not limited to, the following:
• We earn substantially all of our revenues based on AUM, and any reduction in AUM would reduce our revenues and profitability.
• The ongoing conflicts and potential military conflicts in Ukraine, Venezuela, China/Taiwan and/or the Middle East have, and will likely continue to, negatively impact the global economy.
• We are exposed to risks arising from our International Activities.
• If our strategies perform poorly, clients could redeem their assets and we could suffer a decline in our AUM, which would reduce our earnings.

paragraphs: The objective of this section of the Annual Report on Form 10-K is to provide a discussion and analysis, from management's perspective, of the key performance indicators and material information necessary to assess our financial condition, results of operations, liquidity and cash flows for the year ended December 31, 2025. The following discussion should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements and related notes that appear in Part II – Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data of this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations included in this report discusses our financial condition and results of operations as of and for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024. A discussion related to our financial condition and results of operations for 2024 as compared to 2023 can be found in Part II - Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024, filed with the SEC on February 28, 2025.

In addition to historical information, this discussion and analysis contain forward‑looking statements that involve risks, uncertainties and assumptions, which could cause actual results to differ materially from management's expectations. Please refer to the sections of this report entitled "Forward‑Looking Statements" and "Risk Factors."

Our Business – Victory is a diversified global asset management firm with total client assets of $316.6 billion, assets under management of $313.8 billion and other assets of $2.8 billion as of December 31, 2025. The Company operates a next-generation business model combining boutique investment qualities with the benefits of an integrated, centralized operating and distribution platform.

The Company provides specialized investment strategies to institutions, intermediaries, retirement platforms and individual investors with multiple autonomous Investment Franchises and a Solutions Platform. Victory Capital offers a wide array of investment products, including actively and passively managed mutual funds, rules-based and active exchange traded funds ("ETFs"), institutional separate accounts, variable insurance products ("VIPs"), alternative investments, private closed end funds, and a 529 Education Savings Plan. Victory Capital's strategies are also offered through third-party investment products, including mutual funds, third-party ETF model strategies, retail separately managed accounts ("SMAs") and unified managed accounts ("UMAs") through wrap account programs, Collective Investment Trusts ("CITs"), and undertakings for the collective investment in transferable securities ("UCITS"). As of December 31, 2025, our Franchises and our Solutions Platform collectively managed a diversified set of 187 investment strategies for a wide range of institutional and retail clients and direct investors.

Franchises – Our Franchises are largely operationally integrated but are separately branded and make investment decisions independently from one another within guidelines established by their respective investment mandates. Our largely integrated model creates a supportive environment in which our investment professionals, largely unencumbered by administrative and operational responsibilities, can focus on their pursuit of investment excellence. VCM employs all of our U.S. investment professionals across our Franchises, which are not separate legal entities.

Solutions – Our Solutions Platform consists of multi‑asset, multi-manager, quantitative, rules-based, factor-based, and customized portfolios. These strategies are designed to achieve specific return characteristics, with products that include values-based and thematic outcomes and exposures. We offer our Solutions Platform through a variety of vehicles, including separate accounts, mutual funds, UMA accounts, and rules-based and active ETFs under our VictoryShares ETF brand. Like our Franchises, our Solutions Platform is operationally integrated and supported by our centralized distribution, marketing, and operational support functions.

Professionals within our institutional and retail distribution channels, direct investor business and marketing organization sell our products through our centralized distribution model. Our institutional sales team focuses on cultivating relationships with institutional consultants, who account for the majority of the institutional market, as well as asset allocators seeking sub-advisers. Our retail sales team offers intermediary and retirement

platform clients, including broker-dealers, retirement platforms and RIA networks, mutual funds and ETFs as well as SMAs through wrap fee programs and access to our investment models through UMAs. Our direct investor business serves the investment needs of individual clients.

We have grown our total client assets from $17.9 billion following the management-led buyout in August 2013 to $316.6 billion at December 31, 2025. We attribute this growth to our success in sourcing acquisitions and evolving them into organic growers, generating strong investment returns, and developing institutional, retail, international, and direct investor channels with deep penetration.

Pioneer Investments - On April 1, 2025, the Company completed the transactions contemplated by the Contribution Agreement to combine Amundi's U.S. business into the Company and reintroduced the brand Pioneer Investments for the acquired business and investment products. The addition of Pioneer Investments as the Company's largest Investment Franchise meaningfully enhances the Company's scale, expands its global client base and further diversifies its investment capabilities. The sequential results reflect Pioneer Investments as of April 1, 2025, which significantly impacted our financial results for the year ended December 31, 2025 when compared to the comparable periods. Refer to Notes 1 and 4 of the consolidated financial statements for further details related to the acquisition.

• AUM at December 31, 2025 and 2024 was $313.8 billion and $171.9 billion, respectively. We generated $60.0 billion in gross flows and $4.5 billion in net outflows for the year ended December 31, 2025 compared to $26.2 billion in gross flows and $7.4 billion in net outflows for the same period in 2024. Net flows for the year ended December 31, 2025 were comprised of $4.2 billion and $0.3 billion of net long-term and short-term outflows, respectively.

• 54 of our Victory Capital mutual funds and ETFs had overall Morningstar ratings of four or five stars and 65% of our fund and ETF AUM were rated four or five stars overall by Morningstar. 63% of our strategies by AUM had investment returns in excess of their respective benchmarks over a one-year period, 63% over a three-year period, 68% over a five-year period and 78% over a ten-year period. On an equal-weighted basis, 60% of our strategies have outperformed their benchmarks over a one-year period, 62% over a three-year period, 69% over a five-year period and 68% over a ten-year period.
• Total revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025 was $1.3 billion compared to $893.5 million for the year ended December 31, 2024.

paragraphs: 本公司為一家多元化全球資產管理公司，截至2025年12月31日，總資產規模（"AUM"）為313.8 十億美元，總客戶資產為316.6 十億美元。本公司差異化的商業模式結合精品投資的特性，並享有規模化、整合式、集中式（非標準化）運營與分銷平台的優勢。

Victory Capital為機構、中介、退休平台及個人投資者提供專業投資策略。透過多個投資品牌與解決方案平台，各自維持投資流程的自主性，Victory Capital提供廣泛的投資產品，包括主動與被動管理的共同基金、基於規則與主動交易的交易所交易基金（"ETFs"）、機構分離帳戶、變動保險產品（"VIPs"）、另類投資、私人封閉基金，以及529教育儲蓄計畫。Victory Capital的策略亦透過第三方投資產品提供，包括共同基金、第三方ETF模型策略、零售分離管理帳戶（"SMAs"）與統一管理帳戶（"UMAs"）透過包裝帳戶計畫、集體投資信託（"CITs"）以及集合投資於可轉讓證券的計畫（"UCITS"）。截至2025年12月31日，我們的投資品牌與解決方案平台共同管理187種多元化投資策略。

本公司設計的商標與標誌，包括"Victory Capital"、"Victory Capital Management"、"Victory Funds"、"VictoryShares"、"Victory Capital inVest"、"Victory Capital Solutions"、"inVest"、"Munder"、"Munder Capital"、"New Energy Capital"、"Pioneer Investments"、"THB"、"The Road to Victory"、"RS Investments"、"Sycamore Capital"、"Trivalent Investments"、"Victory Income Investors"及"WestEnd Advisors"，截至2025年12月31日為本公司所有或正在申請中。本報告中出現的其他商標、服務標誌及商名，均為其各自所有者所有。

本公司之設計標誌及標記「Victory Capital」、「Victory Capital Management」、「Victory Funds」、「VictoryShares」、「Victory Capital inVest」、「Victory Capital Solutions」、「inVest」、「Munder」、「Munder Capital」、「New Energy Capital」、「Pioneer Investments」、「THB」、「The Road to Victory」、「RS Investments」、「Sycamore Capital」、「Trivalent Investments」、「Victory Income Investors」及「WestEnd Advisors」，截至2025年12月31日為止，為本公司所擁有或申請中。本報告中出現之其他商標、服務標誌及商名，均為其各自所有者所有。

Victory Capital Holdings, Inc. 於 2013 年成立，目的是為取得 Victory Capital Management ("VCM") 及 Victory Capital Services, Inc. ("VCS") 從 KeyCorp。VCM 是美國註冊的投資顧問 ("RIA")，透過開放式共同基金、機構分離帳戶、CITs、包裝帳戶計畫、UCITS、私人基金及 ETF 管理資產。VCM 還為 Victory Portfolios、Victory Variable Insurance Funds、Victory Portfolios II 的共同基金系列、Victory Portfolios III、Victory Portfolios IV (合稱 "Victory Funds")，一組開放式共同基金，以及 VictoryShares (本公司 ETF 品牌) 提供共同基金行政服務。此外，VCM 僱用本公司所有美國投資專業人員，分佈於其 Franchises 和 Solutions，這些並非獨立法律實體。
我們有明確的策略，旨在為客戶、員工與股東實現持續的盈利成長與成功。我們針對追求有機與無機成長均有專注的策略。

有機成長 – 我們透過提供具價值增加與解決方案導向的策略，來實現有機成長，這些策略針對具長期強風險調整表現記錄的投資組合。我們成長策略的關鍵驅動力在於強化現有投資品牌的實力。我們主要透過提供運營平台、技術、分銷、行銷、產品開發及其他支援功能的存取，來達成此目標。我們集中化的分銷模式為其提供強大的成長引擎，透過積極尋找新客戶並提供服務與報告，同時吸收行政與運營複雜性，使投資專業人員能專注於他們擅長的事項：管理資產與培養長期客戶關係。我們亦透過新產品開發與優化產品包裝，協助投資品牌保持競爭力與對市場機會的靈活反應。
我們亦透過新產品開發與優化產品包裝，協助投資品牌保持競爭力與對市場機會的靈活反應。
我們持續評估並投資以改善我們的運營平台。近期的措施包括投資於人工智慧（"AI"）、數據與分析、科技、產品開發、美國與國際物流配送以及行銷，以提升我們業務的內生性成長並增加我們配送渠道的效益。
非內生性成長 – 我們透過戰略性收購來補強我們的內生性成長。我們主要尋求收購投資管理公司，以增加高品質的投資團隊、提升我們的成長與財務表現、改善我們的資產類別與投資能力的多元化、達成我們的整合與協同效益目標，並擴大我們的配送能力。
在競爭激烈的併購環境中，我們的一個關鍵優勢是我們能提供多個配送渠道的接觸機會。我們的銷售與行銷平台透過開拓新的配送渠道並深入現有渠道，來推動我們收購的投資品牌實現內生性成長。此銷售與行銷專業人員的支持，使我們的投資專業人員能專注於提供卓越的投資表現。

自我們在2013年由KeyCorp領導的買斷後，我們已成功完成八項收購，並退出兩項少數投資，截至2025年12月31日，我們的總客戶資產從17.9十億美元成長至316.6十億美元，成長幅度為1,669%。我們瞭解在執行交易時需盡量減少對投資團隊與客戶體驗的幹擾。我們的團隊非常有經驗，並有成功達成這些目標的歷史紀錄。先前的收購已使我們的產品多元化，並在我們能成功並賺取可持續管理費的資產類別中，提供了多樣化的投資策略。

在2025年，我們完成了與Amundi SA（"Amundi"）的戰略交易，將其美國業務（"Amundi US"）併入Victory Capital，並建立了獨家的長期全球配送協議，Amundi成為Victory Capital的戰略股東。Amundi US重組後重新品牌為Pioneer Investments，成為我們最大的投資品牌，這項收購大幅提升了我們的規模，擴大了我們的全球客戶基礎，並進一步多元化我們的投資與產品能力。
我們定期評估潛在收購目標，並維持一個強大的產業參與者與顧問網路，以提供機會建立潛在目標關係與尋找交易。我們的管理團隊領導並參與我們的收購策略，運用他們多年來實際運作公司的經驗，成功尋找、執行、整合並最終運作收購後的企業。

paragraphs: 本年度報表 10-K 之本節目標在於從管理階層的觀點，提供有關關鍵績效指標及評估本公司財務狀況、營運成果、流動性及現金流所必需的重要資訊，以說明 2025 年 12 月 31 日為結算日之年度表現。以下討論應配合本年度報表 10-K 之 Part II – Item 8. 財務報表及補充資料中所載之合併財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀。

本報告所包含之「財務狀況與營運成果之管理討論與分析」，討論本公司截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日及 2024 年 12 月 31 日之財務狀況與營運成果。有關 2024 年財務狀況與營運成果與 2023 年比較之討論，請參閱本公司 2024 年 12 月 31 日年度報告表 10-K 之「財務狀況與營運成果之管理討論與分析」，該報告於 2025 年 2 月 28 日提交至美國證券交易委員會（SEC）。
除了歷史資訊外，本討論與分析包含前瞻性陳述，涉及風險、不確定性與假設，這些因素可能導致實際結果與管理階層預期有重大差異。請參閱本報告中標題為「前瞻性陳述」及「風險因素」之部分。
本公司業務 – Victory 為一多元化全球資產管理公司，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，總客戶資產為 316.6 十億美元，管理資產為 313.8 十億美元，其他資產為 2.8 十億美元。本公司運作一項結合精品投資特質與整合式、集中式運作與分銷平台優勢之新一代商業模式。

本公司為機構、中介機構、退休平台及個人投資者提供專門化投資策略，包含多項自主投資品牌（Investment Franchises）與解決方案平台（Solutions Platform）。Victory Capital 提供廣泛之投資產品，包括主動與被動管理之共同基金、基於規則與主動管理之交易所交易基金（"ETFs"）、機構分離帳戶、變動保險產品（"VIPs"）、另類投資、私人封閉式基金，以及 529 教育儲蓄計畫。Victory Capital 之策略亦透過第三方投資產品提供，包括共同基金、第三方 ETF 模式策略、零售分離管理帳戶（"SMAs"）與統一管理帳戶（"UMAs"）透過包裝帳戶計畫（wrap account programs）、集體投資信託（"CITs"）及集體投資於可轉讓證券之計畫（"UCITS"）。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司之投資品牌與解決方案平台共同管理 187 種多元化投資策略，服務廣泛之機構與零售客戶及直接投資者。
投資品牌 – 我們之投資品牌在運作上 largely 積合，但為獨立品牌，並根據各自投資授權之指引，獨立進行投資決策。我們 largely 積合之模式創造出支持性環境，使我們之投資專業人員 largely 不受行政與運作責任束縛，專注於追求投資卓越。VCM 聘請我們所有美國投資專業人員，服務於各投資品牌，這些品牌並非獨立法律實體。

解決方案 – 我們之解決方案平台包含多資產、多管理人、量化、基於規則、因子基準及客製化投資組合。這些策略設計用以達成特定回報特性，包含價值導向與主題性結果與風險敞口。我們透過多種工具提供解決方案平台，包括分離帳戶、共同基金、UMA 帳戶，以及透過 VictoryShares ETF 品牌提供之基於規則與主動管理 ETF。與我們之投資品牌一樣，我們之解決方案平台在運作上為積合，並由我們集中式分銷、行銷與運作支援功能支援。
我們機構與零售分銷通路、直接投資業務及行銷組織之專業人員透過我們集中式分銷模式銷售我們之產品。我們機構銷售團隊專注於與機構顧問建立關係，這些顧問佔機構市場的大多數，以及尋求子管理人的資產配置者。我們零售銷售團隊提供中介與退休
平台客戶，包括證券經紀商、退休平台及RIA網路、共同基金與ETF，以及透過包裝費用方案與電信業者取得我們投資模型的獨立交易帳戶（SMAs）。我們的直接投資者業務服務個人投資者之投資需求。
我們已將總客戶資產從2013年8月由管理層帶領的買斷後的17.9十億美元，成長至2025年12月31日的316.6十億美元。我們歸因於在尋找收購標的與將其轉化為內生成長業務、產生強勁投資回報，以及發展機構、零售、國際與直接投資者通路，並深入滲透市場的成果。

Pioneer Investments - 2025年4月1日，本公司完成根據貢獻協議所預期的交易，將Amundi的美國業務合併至本公司，並重新引入品牌Pioneer Investments用於所收購的業務與投資產品。Pioneer Investments作為本公司最大的投資品牌，顯著提升本公司的規模，擴大其全球客戶基礎，並進一步多元化其投資能力。連續性結果反映Pioneer Investments自2025年4月1日起的表現，與2025年12月31日財年相比，對本公司財務結果產生顯著影響。有關收購的進一步細節，請參閱合併財務報表的附註1及附註4。
• 2025年12月31日及2024年12月31日的總管理資產（AUM）分別為313.8十億美元及171.9十億美元。我們在2025年12月31日財年產生60.0十億美元的總流入與4.5十億美元的淨流出，與2024年相同期間的26.2十億美元總流入與7.4十億美元淨流出相比。2025年12月31日財年的淨流出由4.2十億美元的淨長期流出與0.3十億美元的淨短期流出組成。

• 我們的Victory Capital共同基金與ETF中，有54檔獲得Morningstar總體評分四星或五星，且我們基金與ETF的總管理資產中有65%獲得Morningstar總體四星或五星評分。我們的策略中，63%的總管理資產在一年期間的投資回報超過其相應指標，63%在三年期間，68%在五年期間，78%在十年期間。以等權方式計算，我們的策略中，60%在一年期間的投資回報超過其相應指標，62%在三年期間，69%在五年期間，68%在十年期間。
• 2025年12月31日財年的總營業收入為1.3十億美元，與2024年12月31日財年的893.5百萬美元相比。

headings: 我們面臨因國際業務活動而產生的風險
若我們的策略表現不佳，客戶可能贖回其資產，導致我們的管理資產規模下降，進而降低我們的營業收入。
我們策略的歷史回報可能無法反映其未來結果或我們未來可能發展的策略表現。
我們策略的表現或管理資產規模的成長可能受到適當投資機會不足的限制。
關鍵投資專業人員或高階管理團隊成員的流失可能對我們的業務造成重大不利影響。
我們幾乎所有的營業收入均來自可能在短時間或無預告通知下終止的契約與關係。
投資於我們所建議的某些基金之投資人，可隨時無預告通知地贖回其資產。
我們過去幾年所經歷的顯著成長可能難以持續，且我們的成長策略部分取決於我們能否成功進行並整合新的戰略收購。
我們的費用會受到波動影響，這可能會對我們的營運結果產生重大影響。
新業務線或新產品與服務可能使我們面臨聲譽損害、額外成本或營運風險。
我們建立與發展新團隊與策略的努力可能失敗，這可能會對我們的營運結果產生負面影響，也可能對我們的聲譽與文化產生負面影響。
指派可能導致我們的投資顧問契約終止，並可能觸發我們其他投資顧問契約中的同意要求。
我們為Victory Funds、VictoryShares及受託管理的共同基金提供廣泛的服務，這可能使我們面臨責任風險。
潛在的商譽及無形資產減損可能導致無法實現這些資產的價值。
若我們被認定為需依 1940 年法案登記的投資公司，我們將面臨繁重的監管要求，且業務活動可能受到限制。
我們可能無法實現預期的合併與收購效益，因整合困難及其他挑戰。
某些來自收購的負債係估算結果，可能導致對營收產生重大影響。
我們的重大負債可能使我們面臨重大風險。
本公司普通股的市場價格可能波動，並可能下跌。
股東未來出售股份可能導致本公司股票價格下跌。
未能維持有效的財務報告內部控制，可能對本公司業務、營運結果及股票價格造成重大不利影響。
本公司支付定期股息的能力取決於董事會的裁量權及德拉瓦州法律。
未來發行債務或權益證券可能稀釋或優先於本公司普通股。
paragraphs: 下列所描述的風險並非我們唯一面臨的風險。上述任何風險或目前未知的其他風險與不確定性，若發生，可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況或營運成果造成重大且不利的影響。在此情況下，本公司普通股的交易價格可能會下跌。本報告亦包含涉及風險與不確定性的展望性陳述與預估。我們的實際結果可能與展望性陳述中預期的結果有重大差異，原因包括下列風險與不確定性等因素。
下列為影響我們業務、財務狀況或營運成果的風險與不確定性總結。我們提供以下風險因素總結，以提升風險因素揭露的可讀性。可能對我們業務、財務狀況或營運成果造成重大不利影響的關鍵風險，包括但不限於下列項目：
• 我們的收入幾乎全部基於資產總額（AUM），若資產總額減少，將導致我們的收入與利潤減少。
• 歐洲烏克蘭、委內瑞拉、中國/臺灣及/或中東地區持續的衝突與潛在軍事衝突，已並可能持續對全球經濟造成負面影響。
• 我們因國際業務活動而面臨風險。
• 若我們的策略表現不佳，客戶可能贖回其資產，導致我們的資產總額減少，進而降低我們的營收。
